title: Performance & Security Update
headline: Faster animations, tighter security, and a smoother experience from landing page to app.
changes: Improved: Animations throughout the site are now smarter — they pause when off-screen and respect reduced-motion preferences, cutting GPU load and idle CPU drain.
Improved: The landing page and download page are now smoother and more responsive. Scrolling the page no longer re-renders the header.
Improved: Desktop installer updated to 1.1.2 with all the latest fixes and improvements.
Fixed: The server's own CPU usage throttle was not counting system time correctly — it now accounts for all CPU load when deciding whether to back off.
Security: Logging out now immediately invalidates your session token on the server, so a stolen token can't be reused during the brief cache window.
Security: JWT verification cache has tighter limits to prevent stale-token replay at scale.
